I'm a bioinformatician in the Division of Neurosurgery [↗](https://health.uct.ac.za/neurosurgery){target="_blank"} at the University of Cape Town for the African Brain Child Initiative [↗](https://africanbrainchild.com/){target="_blank"}, affiliated to the Neuroscience Institute [↗](https://neuroscience.uct.ac.za/){target="_blank"}. I assist our team with quantitative research on paediatric central nervous system conditions including tuberculous meningitis, traumatic brain injury, and brain tumour classification. I am based in the Institute for Child Health at the Red Cross War Memorial Children's Hospital [↗](https://www.childrenshospitaltrust.org.za/the-hospital/){target="_blank"}.
